metric_defs.directed_f1: F1 over directed edges; undecided pairs oriented by the stated rule
metric_defs.share: share of true edges running earlier column -> later column
metric_defs.shd: structural Hamming distance (variant named in shd_variant)

orientation_rule: random per file (CausalArena Appendix B.2) unless the file states otherwise

controls.knowledge_source: column order of the released file (the layout leak); absent in the shuffled arm

shd_variant: one per unordered pair whose predicted arrows differ (ours; see REP-06)
